etymologies.etymologyHTML: From length +‎ -en.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To make longer, to extend the length of.

quote.citation: 1950 September, “Central London Railway Jubilee”, in Railway Magazine, page 622:
quote.text: The platforms of all stations from Shepherds Bush to Liverpool Street have been lengthened from 325 ft. to 427 ft. between tunnel headwalls, to take longer trains.
